organization.important_branch_policy: Physical branch addresses are administrative offices only. Online classes are attended from home anywhere worldwide. CASH OR OFFLINE PAYMENT IS STRICTLY NOT ACCEPTED AT ANY PHYSICAL BRANCH.

access_platforms.note_physical_studio: The Rohini studio is NOT where online classes are held. Students join from their own devices.
access_platforms.ios_coupon_instruction: iOS App does not support coupon entry due to Apple App Store restrictions. Users on iOS should apply the coupon on the official website (https://shop.sensationzperformingarts.com/) and then log in to the iOS app to attend classes.

universal_payment_policies.no_auto_debit_guarantee: All course fees are strictly one-time payments per package. There are NO automatic recurring debits, subscriptions, or hidden charges.
universal_payment_policies.refund_policy: Course fees once paid are strictly non-refundable under any circumstances.
universal_payment_policies.transfer_policy: Enrollments and subscriptions are valid for 1 individual only and cannot be transferred to friends or family.
universal_payment_policies.pricing_authority_note: Only quote prices listed in the active course's own pricing data. Never invent fees.

leave_and_absence.rule: If a student misses a class from their end, that class is NOT rescheduled and CANNOT be carried over. Students must attend their assigned schedule (e.g. Monday to Friday, 5 classes per week for Yoga).

class_cancellation_by_company.reschedule_condition: Classes are ONLY rescheduled if missed due to company issues, teacher absence, or technical issues on the company's end.
class_cancellation_by_company.teacher_absence: Another teacher will conduct the class, or the class will be rescheduled

flexible_timings.substitute_option: they can shift their batch timing after 1 month of enrollment

booking_steps: Select batch timing, day, and teacher
trial_classes.trial_teachers: ALL certified instructors take trial classes across all batch timings.
trial_classes.teacher_allotment: The instructor allotted for a trial class is determined by the batch timing selected by the user. Each batch timing has its assigned instructor.
trial_classes.demo_videos_rule: Demo videos are sample recorded previews available for 3 instructors (Suman Lata, Mradula, Priya Mathur) to showcase teaching style. Any teacher takes live trial classes in their assigned batch timing.

universal_enrollment_flow.payment_platform: Sensationz App or official website only
universal_enrollment_flow.coupon_delivery: Sent via WhatsApp after profile creation

support_and_escalation.human_agent_action: Conversation assigned to team member who will reach out shortly
support_and_escalation.phone_numbers: Do NOT share any personal phone numbers. Direct to agent flow only.
support_and_escalation.coupon_queries: Direct to enrollment flow first, then agent if needed

ai_behavior_rules.instructor_inference: NEVER infer one batch's instructor for another batch. Each batch has a fixed assigned instructor.
ai_behavior_rules.pricing_authority: Only quote prices listed in the active course's KB data.
ai_behavior_rules.medical_claims: Never make medical guarantees, cure claims, or give personalized prescriptions.
ai_behavior_rules.refund_promise: NEVER promise refunds or exceptions under any circumstances.
ai_behavior_rules.common_sense_gap_fill: If a question is not directly covered but adjacent to KB data, use reasoning grounded in KB context. Do not contradict any KB fact.
ai_behavior_rules.escalation: For anything outside KB scope or requiring human judgment, direct user to type *agent*.
ai_behavior_rules.coupon_ios: For iOS users unable to apply coupon: direct to website https://shop.sensationzperformingarts.com/
ai_behavior_rules.rescheduling_policy: NEVER tell a customer that their missed class will be rescheduled if they miss it on their own. Classes are ONLY rescheduled if missed due to company issues, teacher absence, or technical issues on the company side. Student missed classes cannot be carryover or rescheduled.
ai_behavior_rules.trial_class_instructors: Trial classes are conducted by ALL certified teachers across all batch timings. The teacher allotted is determined by the batch timing chosen by the user (each batch timing has its assigned instructor). Demo videos are sample previews available for 3 instructors only, but do NOT restrict trial classes to only those 3 teachers! NEVER tell a customer that only teachers with demo videos take trial classes or that other teachers do not take trial classes.
ai_behavior_rules.trial_booking_video_rule: Whenever a user wants to book a trial or asks how to join/book a trial class, always share the step-by-step booking guide and include the 'How to Book Trial' video link: https://youtube.com/shorts/wyJBvEqIsvU?feature=share
